summary: Threat modeling verified: All 6 STRIDE categories mitigated with low residual risk.

stride_categories.potential_risk: Forged user identity or JWT signature bypass
stride_categories.mitigation_mechanism: Strict asymmetric RS256 JWT validation + short expiry + token revocation list

stride_categories.potential_risk: Unauthorized document modification in transit or storage
stride_categories.mitigation_mechanism: Immutable SHA-256 integrity hashing + S3 WORM Object Lock

stride_categories.potential_risk: User or worker denying performed action
stride_categories.mitigation_mechanism: Cryptographically chained append-only audit ledger with UTC timestamps

stride_categories.potential_risk: Sensitive document leakage or secret exposure in logs
stride_categories.mitigation_mechanism: Automated regex secret scrubbing + AES-256 KMS envelope encryption at rest

stride_categories.potential_risk: Resource exhaustion via 10k RPS flood or massive PDFs
stride_categories.mitigation_mechanism: Token-bucket rate limiting + max upload payload size ceiling (25MB)

stride_categories.potential_risk: Container escape or user accessing admin APIs
stride_categories.mitigation_mechanism: Non-root execution (UID 10001) + read-only rootfs + strict RBAC role gates
